owen: hi everyone, owen here, first day on infra team. trying to build the inference runtime from source on WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04) with an RTX 4090 loaner. following the onboarding guide but cmake/make dies. anyone have 5 min? :wave:

tara: welcome! can you paste the cmake/make snippet and `nvcc --version` + `nvidia-smi`? WSL2 tends to expose driver libs differently.

owen: thanks. nvcc -> Cuda compilation tools, release 12.2, V12.2.89. nvidia-smi driver 535. main errors:

```
/opt/cuda/include/host_config.h:56:10: fatal error: cuda_runtime_api.h: No such file or directory
 #include <cuda_runtime_api.h>
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lcuda
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
nvcc: error: unsupported GNU version! gcc versions later than 11 are not supported by this release.
```

devex: looks classic: (1) headers from /opt/cuda being picked up while toolkit lives in /usr/local/cuda-12.2, (2) libcuda only visible under /usr/lib/wsl, (3) nvcc/gcc mismatch. Quick checks: `ls -l /usr/local/cuda-12.2/include`, `ls -l /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so*`, `echo $CUDA_HOME $LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `gcc --version`.

tara: if $CUDA_HOME empty, export it: `export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.2; export PATH=$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH` then `rm -rf build && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=$CUDA_HOME -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-11 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-11`

owen: ran checks. /usr/local/cuda-12.2 exists with headers, /opt/cuda is a stale symlink to nowhere, libcuda only at /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so -> /proc/driver/nvidia/000. CUDA_HOME was empty, set it. cmake now finds CUDA, but link still fails on -lcuda.

devex: if libcuda is only under /usr/lib/wsl, you can add `-L/usr/lib/wsl` to link dirs or better: build in dev-container (ghcr.io/redwood-inference/dev-container:cuda-12.2) or ask infra for a VM. Also run `sudo ldconfig` after installing toolkit or create `/etc/ld.so.conf.d/cuda.conf` with `/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64` and `sudo ldconfig`.

infra: i can spin up a gpu-dev VM (48h) with cuda 12.2 + gcc-11 if you want. reply "infra vm" here and i'll allocate. we do this for new hires all the time.

owen: yes please infra vm, that'd be great. quick Q: why does nvcc complain about gcc 13 on this box? system has gcc-13 as default.

tara: nvcc bundles support for specific host compilers per CUDA version. older nvcc rejects >gcc-11 for CUDA 12.2 in some patches. install gcc-11/g++-11 and point cmake to them, or use container where toolchain already matches. `sudo apt install gcc-11 g++-11` or use `update-alternatives` to add them temporarily.

owen: infra created DEVVM-812, creds sent. tried the VM and build succeeded after forcing gcc-11 and setting CUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR. thanks! i'll open a tiny devex doc PR to add WSL caveat + recommend the dev-container/VM for GPU builds.

build-bot: CI job rtx-wsl-12.2 requeued by @tara due to WSL matrix failures: https://ci.redwood.dev/rtx-wsl-12.2/2042

devex: thanks, i'll add an onboarding checklist item: "If building on WSL: prefer dev-container or infra VM; ensure CUDA toolkit installed (not just driver); set CUDA_HOME and LD_LIBRARY_PATH; use gcc-11 for CUDA 12.x."

owen: super helpful. closing the loop here, and happy to pair on the doc PR. :tada:
